```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(ggplot2)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)
```

# Load data

```{r}
# Load ALDER results
dates <- readRDS("../results/s11_ALDER/alder_results.RData")
# Load KML
kml_data <- sf::st_read(dsn = "../data/raw/data_input/Data_with_pierron.kml")
kml_data <- sf::st_transform(kml_data, crs = 29702)
#Add names
kml_data$Name <- c("Merina","Sakalava_Tsimihety","Betsimisaraka","Betsileo","Diego", "Temoro","Vezo","Mikea","Mikea","Mikea","Mikea","Mikea","Mikea","Mikea")

kml_data <- kml_data %>%
  mutate(x = st_coordinates(.)[, 1], 
         y = st_coordinates(.)[, 2])
```


```{r}
# match kml_data$Name and dates rownames
matching <- match(kml_data$Name, rownames(dates))

# add admixture date and CI to kml_data
kml_data$date <- dates[matching,"admixture_date"]
kml_data$CI <- dates[matching,"CI"]


ours <- rep(0,5)
pierron <- rep(1,9)
sample <- c(ours,pierron)
kml_data$sample <- sample

kml_data <- kml_data[order(kml_data$Name),]

# Add plot shape
kml_data$shape <- c(1,3,7,15,17,17,17,17,17,17,17,19,21,23)

# add admixture date in years (gen time 29 years)
kml_data$years <- paste(round(kml_data$date * 29, 0),"\u00b1", round(kml_data$CI * 29, 0), "BP")


labels_data <- kml_data %>%
  group_by(Name) %>%
  reframe(
    x = mean(x),
    y = mean(y),
    date = years,
    geometry = st_centroid(st_union(geometry))  # Optional: Keeps geometry if needed
  )

# Mikea has multiple locations, remove duplicates and leave only one row to label
labels_data <- labels_data[!duplicated(labels_data$Name),]
```

# Create map

```{r}
# List possibly relevant countries
target <- c("Madagascar", "Mozambique", "Comoros", "Mauritius", "Seychelles", "Mayotte", "United Republic of Tanzania", "Malawi", "Zimbabwe", "South Africa", "Eswatini", "Zambia","Lesotho", "Somalia", "Kenya", "Ethiopia", "Uganda", "Rwanda", "Burundi", "Djibouti", "Eritrea", "South Sudan","Botswana", "Namibia", "Angola", "Democratic Republic of the Congo", "Central African Republic", "Republic of the Congo", "Equatorial Guinea", "Cameroon") 

# Create an inset of Madagascar
Madagascar_inset <- ne_countries(country = target, type = "map_units", scale = 50)

Madagascar_dissolved <- Madagascar_inset %>%
  st_union() %>%
  st_as_sf() 
```

# Plot

```{r}
ggplot()+
  geom_sf(data = Madagascar_dissolved)+
  geom_sf(data = sf::st_as_sf(kml_data),aes(shape = Name, color = Name, fill = Name), size = 2)+
  coord_sf(crs = st_crs(29702), xlim = c(-1000000,1800000), ylim = c(1,2000000),expand = FALSE) + # Laborde projection, commonly used for Madagascar
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F0F8FF", color = NA)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,3,7,15,17,19,21,23)) +
   labs(shape = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, color = "Population", shape = "Population", fill = "Population")+
  geom_label_repel(data = labels_data, force = 4, force_pull = 1, aes(x = x, y = y, label = date), size = 3, nudge_y = 2, segment.color = 'transparent')+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2")+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2")+
  guides()
```
